headline: Approved permits for Greek and Latino festivals in September, plus taxi and solicitor licenses.
summary: Two City Cab of Fitchburg taxi driver applications were approved, along with four Primetime Solutions solicitor applications. Alexander Guevara's solicitor approval carries a twelve-month review. Entertainment and one-day alcohol permits for the Greek Festival and Latino Festival were also approved.
decisions: Approved minutes of the July 20, 2026 regular meeting and the August 7 and August 13, 2026 special meetings, as amended, 3-0.
Approved taxi driver application for Fernando Cuevas of City Cab of Fitchburg LLC, 2-0.
Approved taxi driver application for Andrew Grace of City Cab of Fitchburg LLC, 2-0.
Approved solicitor applications for Adhiraj Budukh and Jeremy Medina of Primetime Solutions, 2-0.
Approved solicitor application for Kaamil Jenkins of Primetime Solutions, 2-0.
Approved solicitor application for Alexander Guevara of Primetime Solutions with a twelve-month review, 2-0.
Approved amended Monday through Saturday entertainment permit for the Greek Festival at 1319 Main Street, 3-0.
Approved entertainment permit for the Latino Festival at Riverfront Park, 0 Boulder Drive, 3-0.
Approved amended special one-day wine and malt beverages permit for the Greek Festival at 1319 Main Street, 3-0.
Approved amended special one-day all alcoholic beverages permit for the Latino Festival at Riverfront Park, 3-0.

Monty Tech                    BOARD OF LICENSE COMMISSIONERS 
         City Hall, 718 Main Street 
              Fitchburg MA  01420

Daniel Sarefield, Chairman        
Richard Boscardin 
Glenn Fossa 
MINUTES OF MEETING 
A regular meeting of the Board of License Commissioners was held on Thursday, September 3, 2026, called to 
order by Commissioner Sarefield at 6:01 PM. Commissioner Boscardin and Commissioner Fossa were present. 
FPD Liaison Lt. Christopher Bellofatto was present. City Clerk Joanna Bilotta was present.   
I. REVIEW AND APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF PRIOR MEETING(S) 
Regular Minutes of July 20, 2026 and Special Minutes of August 7th and August 13, 2026. 
The regular minutes of July 20, 2026 and special minutes of August 7th and August 13, 2026 were 
amended and approved by roll call vote 3/0.  
 
II. NEW APPLICATIONS 
Please note that the Commission may enter into Executive Session pursuant to G.L. c. 30A, sec. 21(a) 
(5) (Discussion of CORI results), if required during this portion of the agenda, and will return to 
regular session upon completion. 
 
Commissioner Boscardin left at 6:35 PM. Commissioner Sarefield took items out of order.  
 
Taxi Driver Application 
 Fernando Cuevas – City Cab of Fitchburg LLC  
 Mr. Cuevas were present at the meeting. Commissioner Sarefield discussed the Taxi & Livery Service 
 Regulations, as well as Mr. Cuevas driving history.   
 Commissioner Sarefield co nfirmed with City Clerk Joanna Bilotta that a CORI was run.  
 Application  approved by unanimous roll call vote 2/0.     
 Andrew Grace – City Cab of Fitchburg LLC 
 Mr. Gra ce were present at the meeting. Commissioner Sarefield discussed the Taxi & Livery Service 
 Regulations, as well as Mr. Grace’s driving history. Mr. Grace informed the commission   
 this is a renewal license, and has been driving in the city for years.  
 Commissioner Sarefield co nfirmed with City Clerk  Joanna Bilotta that a C ORI was run.  
 Application approved by unanimous roll call vote 2/0.
Page 2 
 
Solicitor Application 
Adhiraj Budukh – Primetime Solutions   
Alexander Guevara – Primetime Solutions   
Kaamil Jenkins – Primetime Solutions   
Jeremy Medina – Primetime Solutions   
 
Mr. Budukh, Mr. Guevara, Mr. Jenkins, and Mr. Medina were present at the meeting. The commission 
took up the applications of Mr. Budukh and Mr. Medina as a group, and will review applications for Mr. 
Guevara and Mr. Jenkins separately. Commissioner Sarefield advised they need to wear Identification 
and the City of Fitchburg Solicitation hours are Monday – Saturday 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM, no Sundays or 
Holiday hours.  
 
Lieutenant Bellofatto informed the applicants that they are responsible to notify the police department of 
what areas of the city they will be working each day. Commissioner Sarefield also shared that they 
should notify the Police Department of the vehicles they will be using while soliciting.  
 
Applications for Mr. Budukh and Mr. Medina approved by roll call vote 2/0.  
 
Commission enters into Executive Session pursuant to G.L. c. 30A, sec. 21(a) (5) (Discussion of CORI         
 results), if required during this portion of the agenda, and will return to regular session upon                                                         
completion. 
 
Roll Call Vote to enter into Executive Session at 6:55 PM, approved by unanimous roll call vote 3/0 
 
Commission returns to regular session at 7:30 PM 
 
Application approved for Mr. Jenkins by roll call vote 2/0.  
 
Application approved for Mr. Guevara with a twelve-month review by roll call vote 2/0.  
 
 Monday – Saturday Entertainment Pe rmit  
Joanne Donnelly, Holy Trinity Greek Church, Greek Festival, 1319 Main Street, Friday, September 
11th, from 4:00 PM – 9:00 PM and Saturday, September 12th 2026, from 11:00 AM – 11:00 PM, for DJ 
and dancing for approximately 100 people on Friday, September 11th and for approximately 500 people 
on Saturday, September 12, 2026.  
Ms. Donnelly was present at the meeting. Commissioner reviewed the application and verified that Ms. 
Donnelly is aware that all entertainment must be shut down thirty minutes prior to closing. Ms. 
Donnelly asked to extend the end time for Friday, September 11th to 11:00 PM. Ms. Donnelly informed 
the commission this will be the same set up as years past.  
No concerns from Lt. Bellofatto. 
Amended application approved by unanimous roll call vote 3/0.
Page 3 
 
Jainny Andrews, Riverfront Park, 0 Boulder Drive, Latino Festival, Friday, September 18, 2026 for live 
amplified & acoustic music, dancing, and DJ, from 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM, for approximately 200 people.  
Ms. Andrews was present at the meeting. Commissioner reviewed the application and verified that Ms. 
Andrews is aware that all entertainment must be shut down thirty minutes prior to closing. Ms. Andrews 
informed the commission this will be the same set up as years past.  
No concerns from Lt. Bellofatto. 
Application approved by unanimous roll call vote 3/0.  
Special One Day Wine & Malt Beverages 
Joanne Donnelly, Holy Trinity Greek Church, Greek Festival, 1319 Main Street, Friday, September 
11th, from 4:00 PM – 9:00 PM, for approximately 100 people, Saturday, September 12th, from 11:00 
AM – 11:00 PM, for approximately 500 people, and Sunday, September 13, 2026 from 11:00 AM – 
5:00 PM for approximately 100 people.   
Ms. Donnelly was present at the meeting. Commissioner Sarefield reviewed the application and verified 
that the events will have TIP certified servers. Commissioner Sarefield stated that all serving of alcohol 
must be ceased thirty minutes prior to closing. Ms. Donnelly asked to extend the end time for Friday, 
September 11th to 11:00 PM 
 No concerns from Lt. Bellofatto.  
Amended application approved by unanimous roll call vote 3/0. 
Special One Day All Alcoholic Beverages 
Celene Diabo, Riverfront Park, 0 Boulder Drive, Latino Festival, Friday, September 18, 2026 from 5:00 
PM to 9:00 PM, for approximately 100 people.  
Ms. Diabo was present at the meeting. Commissioner Sarefield reviewed the application and verified 
that the events will have TIP certified servers. Commissioner Sarefield stated that all serving of alcohol 
must be ceased thirty minutes prior to closing. Ms. Diabo asked to extend the end time to 11:00 PM.  
 No concerns from Lt. Bellofatto.  
Amended application approved by unanimous roll call vote 3/0. 
 
 
III. CORRESPONDENCE  
 
 
 
 
IV. NEW BUSINESS
